scope.split_condition: p+q=50, p<=q, and either p*q < 637-c or B=p*q-(637-c) satisfies p-B>=9 and q-B>=9

proof: Any canonical raw state with K<=636 clauses has at most 1+636+Wmax_6(636)=3361 storage units, below 58^2=3364. Thus a cap violation requires K>=637.
Let c=m-d retained clauses. K>=637 requires at least t=637-c genuinely new distinct resolvents. If p*q<t, this is impossible immediately, so K<=636.

Otherwise choose one producing cross-parent pair for each of t distinct new resolvents, forming an injective non-tautological representative set G. At most B=p*q-t cross pairs lie outside G. Therefore at least p-B entire P rows and q-B entire Q columns are clean.

Under the stated clean-core condition both P0 and Q0 contain at least nine distinct nonempty tails. Also c<=31 gives t>=606>486, so the G outputs necessarily exhibit both signs of every nonpivot coordinate.

A coordinate cannot be active in both clean cores: a clean row and clean column containing it force one common sign through all parent occurrences and therefore through G, contradicting the required opposite sign.
Nine distinct nonempty ternary tails require at least three active coordinates because 3^2-1=8. Thus the disjoint P0/Q0 supports consume exactly 3+3 of the six coordinates; call them A and B.

Every P tail has a unique projection onto A. Two distinct P tails with the same A projection would have distinct B masks b1,b2. Every q in clean Q0 is compatible with both and injectivity of G requires different unions. The exact THREE_COORDINATE_TWO_MASK_SEPARATION lemma allows at most eight such nonzero q, contradicting |Q0|>=9.
Projection injectivity implies at most 2*3^2=18 P tails contain any fixed A-coordinate.

Because d=50 is the selected minimum live degree, every nonpivot coordinate has degree at least 50. At most c retained clauses contain it, so it occurs in at least 50-c pivot-parent tails. With c<=31 this is at least 19, strictly greater than the P-side ceiling 18. Hence at least one exceptional Q tail contains every A-coordinate.
Every P0 row is clean, so such an exceptional Q tail is compatible with every P0 tail. Its sign forbids the opposite sign throughout P0 on that A-coordinate. This holds on all three A-coordinates.
P0 is supported on A and then has only omission or one permitted sign on each coordinate, allowing at most 2^3-1=7 distinct nonempty tails, contradicting |P0|>=9.
Therefore K>=637 is impossible throughout the stated family. Hence K<=636, L_out<=Wmax_6(636)=2724, and total raw storage is at most 3361<3364.
